items.question: Is this font generator free to use?
items.answer: Yes, AestheticFonts is completely free. There is no sign-up, no download, and no limit on how many times you can generate fonts.

items.question: Will these fonts work on Instagram, WhatsApp and Discord?
items.answer: Yes. The generator converts your text into special Unicode characters, so the styled text works anywhere you can paste plain text, including Instagram bios, WhatsApp status, Discord, Twitter/X and Facebook.

items.question: Do I need to install any font or app?
items.answer: No installation is needed. Everything runs directly in your browser, and the converted text is just copied to your clipboard.

items.question: Why do some styles look like boxes or missing characters?
items.answer: This happens if the platform or device you paste the text into does not support that particular Unicode character. Try a different style if one doesn't render correctly.

items.question: Is my text stored or shared anywhere?
items.answer: No. All conversion happens locally in your browser. We do not store or transmit the text you type into the generator.
